title: Headway Metric1 Hour-of-Day Pattern
dataSources: SimplePractice therapy sessions (`simplepractice:session`), Headway appointments (`headway:appointment`), BetterHelp sessions (`betterhelp:session`), CBT homework logs (`cbt:homework`), and Daylio mood entries (`daylio:mood`).
app: SimplePractice session notes, Headway appointment confirmations, BetterHelp messaging sessions, CBT homework trackers, and Daylio mood exports ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=headway:metric1
| eval hour=strftime(_time,"%H")
| stats count as events by hour source_id
| sort hour
description: Shows which hours of the day headway metric1 (1) events most often occur for each source.
value: Hour-of-day patterns reveal routine anchors, timezone drift, and automation misfires.
implementation: Extract hour from `_time` on headway metric1 (1) events and chart counts by source.
visualization: Heatmap or bar chart of events by hour.
grandmaExplanation: It finds what time of day your headway metric1 (1) feed is busiest and when it goes quiet.
